rows.explainer: **Changed for consistency.** Ambitious Impact subtracts what the co-founders, staff and funding would have achieved at other charities: 114 QALYs a year (its funding and staff counterfactual rows above), Ambitious Impact's own figure, kept in the evaluator view. No other evaluator does this, and it double-counts the comparison the ranking itself makes, so our view leaves it out (owner decision 2026-10-31). Staff's forgone pay is counted instead by our staff-pay step under credit by share of resources.

rows.label: Staff pay as a share of program cost
rows.explainer: Default for programs where staff deliver the help themselves (treatment, counselling, coaching, outreach): staff pay is about half the cost. Our judgment; we haven't seen this program's breakdown.

rows.label: Pay gap versus comparable jobs elsewhere
rows.explainer: Health workers and field staff at nonprofits often earn somewhat less than in comparable jobs. Our judgment.

rows.label: Salary forgone by staff per dollar of cost (in-kind donation)
Share of the full cost paid in cash
rows.explainer: With credit by share of resources, staff's forgone pay counts as part of the cost, and staff get their share of the outcome. Off, this is 100%.

rows.label: Discount rate on future benefits
rows.explainer: The shared discount rate (Your values). Ambitious Impact doesn't discount in this sheet, so the evaluator view pins it at 0.

rows.label: Discount factor for the workbook's effect
rows.explainer: Benefits spread evenly over the years the effect lasts, starting now: their present value as a share of the undiscounted total.

rows.label: DALYs averted per dollar
rows.explainer: Times our discount factor for benefits spread over years. With credit by share of resources, times the share of the full cost paid in cash (staff's forgone pay is the rest).

native.unit: $ per QALY gained (scenario 2: low-income country, new workbooks, paid telephone support)

summary: Ambitious Impact's 2020 estimate for a new charity offering guided self-help for depression: a workbook plus short phone support from lay workers. The idea Kaya Guides was founded to run. Its bottom line is the total cost per QALY gained in the report's most likely low-income-country scenario, with counterfactual costs (what the co-founders, staff and funding would have achieved elsewhere), which our view leaves out for consistency; we read a QALY gained as a DALY averted.

theoretical.reason: Ambitious Impact's estimate of the idea, written before the charity existed; not based on the charity's own results.
theoretical.runs: Kaya Guides runs WHO Step-by-Step guided self-help for depression in India over WhatsApp, with short weekly calls from lay guides.
